subject.title: fix(anthropic): read claudeCodeVersion at runtime to prevent stale user-agent bearer auth failures

question: Should Anthropic OAuth identity headers fail closed on missing @anthropic-ai/claude-code package metadata, or should OpenClaw derive and cache the version from the configured claude-cli backend command/path?
rationale: Both choices affect existing Claude subscription-backed setups, auth-provider behavior, and whether upgrades fail before request construction; repository policy treats this as compatibility-sensitive rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Repair the version source before merge
options.body: Rebase the PR and use a maintainer-approved cached source that works with documented PATH/custom-command Claude CLI setups before failing closed.

options.title: Accept the package metadata requirement
options.body: Require @anthropic-ai/claude-code to be resolvable from OpenClaw's module graph and add dependency, doctor, docs, and upgrade proof for that new requirement.

options.title: Pause for a canonical branch
options.body: Hold or close this branch only after another same-root-cause PR is merged or demonstrably landable with stronger proof.

recommendation.title: Repair the version source before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and use a maintainer-approved cached source that works with documented PATH/custom-command Claude CLI setups before failing closed.
